claim: The root cause was in the fetchLatest function
Live-feed records were merged into the transfer list keyed only by id
The backend classifies fresh tweets/articles as a transfer progresses
An update for the same real-world deal can land under a new id
A stale seed record could have category value of 'talks'
A newer record for the same deal could have category value of 'done'
The stale seed record would sit alongside the new one causing duplicate rendering
The deal rendered in both pipeline columns at once
The fix deduplicates records by a stable identity composed of kind, player, and to fields
The kind, player, and to fields are lowercased when constructing the stable identity key
A later record for the same transfer always overwrites the earlier one regardless of id drift
The fix is located at lines 671-678 of TransferDesk.jsx
